Patched. The skill now covers both the modern country-detail FX variant and the pre-WWII weekly regional capital-movements variant.

Summary of what I saved (the generalizable bits):
- The 1930s bulletins carry a WEEKLY "Capital Movements between the US and ..." table broken out by REGION (Latin America, Europe, Far East), distinct from the modern per-country tables.
- Date arithmetic for "Nth weekday of month" must be resolved literally by counting occurrences of that weekday — "3rd Thursday in Jan 1939" = Jan 19, "4th Wednesday" = Jan 25.
- These pre-WWII tables are already in THOUSANDS of dollars (no scaling), versus millions in modern tables.
- Sign convention: net inflow positive, outflow negative.

No memory entry needed — this is procedural and now lives in the right skill. Done.
